# BigQuery compares the fields of a STRUCT with IS DISTINCT FROM, but not the STRUCT itself.
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/operators#is_distinct
SELECT STRUCT(1, 2) IS DISTINCT FROM STRUCT(1, 2)
=> error:

SELECT STRUCT(1 AS a, NULL AS b) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM STRUCT(1 AS a, NULL AS b)
=> error:

# BigQuery casts a STRUCT only to a STRUCT, and no value to JSON: it answers "Invalid cast from
# STRING to JSON" (https://github.com/ibis-project/ibis/issues/11753) and leaves JSON out of the
# casting table.
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/conversion_rules#casting
SELECT CAST('{"a": 1}' AS JSON)
=> error contains: Invalid cast from STRING to JSON

SELECT CAST(STRUCT(1, 2) AS JSON)
=> error contains: Invalid cast from STRUCT<INT64, INT64> to JSON
